summary: America's Car-Mart filed an 8-K disclosing a further extension of its credit-agreement waiver and scheduled termination date to October 15, 2026, following prior extensions since September 4, 2026. A special board committee continues evaluating strategic alternatives including financing, recapitalization, restructuring, and M&A, with active third-party, agent, and lender discussions and significant progress claimed. The amendment waives anticipated or existing defaults tied to financial covenants, reporting, minimum liquidity, and Collateral Coverage Ratio. No price, stake, premium, advisor, or recommendation was disclosed. Watch for a transaction announcement or further short-dated extensions; risk-arb hinges on lender forbearance runway.
